_comment: Every rule must match exactly once; apply_temp_root.py fails the build
otherwise, so a half-patched APK is never produced.
A) the trash IconButton in the Home TopAppBar (uninstall Magisk)
B) the InstallButton inside CoreCard (Install / Update / Reinstall of the core)
The manager's own update lives in AppCard and must stay untouched.
The edits use `&& false`, which keeps every symbol referenced (no unused
parameter / import warnings that could break an allWarningsAsErrors build)
and removes the widget from the composition.

rules.why: hide the uninstall icon in the Home top app bar

rules.replace: \1val actionLabel: String? = null // TempRoot: no core Install/Update button
rules.why: CoreCard: never offer Install/Update/Reinstall of the Magisk core
